Conduct pattern: Hateful or bigoted speech about a group, with no individual targeted (system output or content people made with AI)
Why US law does not reach it: US: protected speech absent a true threat, incitement, or a targeted person.

Conduct pattern: Stereotyped or biased representation in search results, images, translations, labels, or generated output, with no decision about a person
Why US law does not reach it: US: representational harm; no denial of a job, service, or benefit; protected expression.

Conduct pattern: Unequal accuracy or quality of a consumer product across groups, with no denial of service
Why US law does not reach it: US: public accommodation law needs intent or a denial; no law sets accuracy parity.

Conduct pattern: Platform failed to detect or remove harmful or unlawful third party content
Why US law does not reach it: US: Section 230 bars the claim; no duty to moderate.

Conduct pattern: Platform wrongly removed, labeled, filtered, or suspended lawful content, accounts, or ads through automated moderation
Why US law does not reach it: US: moderation discretion under Section 230(c)(2) and the First Amendment; no right to accuracy or appeal.

Conduct pattern: Recommendation, ranking, or search system amplified harmful, misleading, or skewed but lawful content
Why US law does not reach it: US: ranking is protected editorial judgment; Section 230.

Conduct pattern: AI system gave false, fabricated, or slanted information with no identified victim or shown reliance loss
Why US law does not reach it: US: no duty of accuracy to general readers; protected speech; no injury shown.

Conduct pattern: People posted fabricated media or false claims about public events (disaster, war, crime, wildlife, invented persons) with no identified victim
Why US law does not reach it: US: false speech is protected absent fraud, defamation, or a false report to authorities (Alvarez).

Conduct pattern: Synthetic depiction, satire, or invented words of a real public figure or real deceased person (not sexual, not commercial)
Why US law does not reach it: US: parody and non-defamatory false depictions of public figures are protected.

Conduct pattern: Covert or synthetic political influence: undisclosed bots, fake personas, fake supporters, coordinated propaganda networks
Why US law does not reach it: US: protected political speech; bot and foreign agent laws are narrow.

Conduct pattern: Insulting, vulgar, or disrespectful statement about a named person, official, sovereign, or the state (mistranslation, roast, wrong photo, political criticism)
Why US law does not reach it: US: insult and opinion are protected; no lese majeste, criminal insult, or group libel.

Conduct pattern: Public body's automated decision or tool produced error or unintended disparate impact on people, with no intent shown
Why US law does not reach it: US: equal protection and Title VI need intent; government immunity.

Conduct pattern: Public body or official published inaccurate, AI fabricated, or AI altered material (fake citations, wrong maps, false alerts, altered photos)
Why US law does not reach it: US: no private remedy; accountability is political or administrative.

Conduct pattern: Automated or algorithmic management of workers or applicants with no protected class basis (firing, pay setting, scheduling, replacement, allocation)
Why US law does not reach it: US: at will employment; no just cause rule; contractors outside wage law.

Conduct pattern: Academic, professional, contest, or editorial dishonesty using AI (cheating, undisclosed AI authorship, gaming peer review), and unreliable AI cheating accusations
Why US law does not reach it: US: school, employer, or venue discipline; no crime or tort.

Conduct pattern: Low quality or fabricated AI content in commercial or scholarly publishing (fake citations in books and reports, ghostwritten messages, junk listings)
Why US law does not reach it: US: no law sets editorial quality absent defamation, fraud, or consumer loss.

Conduct pattern: Military, intelligence, or state security use of AI
Why US law does not reach it: US: law of armed conflict, sovereign functions, no US nexus.

Conduct pattern: Surveillance, monitoring, biometric or personal data processing that breaks no US privacy law on the record
Why US law does not reach it: US: no general data protection law; no identified privacy injury.

Conduct pattern: Distressing, abusive, sexual, or unwanted but lawful output directed at the product's own user
Why US law does not reach it: US: not extreme and outrageous; no true threat; adult content sought by adults is lawful.

Conduct pattern: Business decision, commercial conduct, or loss with no legal wrong to another (forecasts, ranking rule changes, pricing bots, agent errors, matching rules)
Why US law does not reach it: US: commercial risk; no antitrust, fraud, or contract hook on the record.

Conduct pattern: Operator or system failed to protect a vulnerable or at risk user, or gave hazardous output, with no US duty or no injury shown
Why US law does not reach it: US: no duty to detect problem gambling; claims need injury.

Conduct pattern: Research finding, benchmark, authorized test, or demonstration with no person affected
Why US law does not reach it: US: no one harmed; no law reaches a finding.

Conduct pattern: Malfunction, product limitation, or near miss with no injury, or harm only to the deployer's own property or reputation
Why US law does not reach it: US: no legal wrong to anyone else.
